curatedMovie.curiosityHook: A priest's cemetery suicide breaches a portal to the underworld, leaving a New York reporter racing an All Saints Day deadline to stop the dead.
curatedMovie.description: During a séance, a psychic appears to die of fright after seeing a priest hanging in a cemetery.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Heavy, suspenseful Italian horror built on supernatural dread, steady investigative tension, and apocalyptic stakes.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: This horror mystery links a reporter’s investigation to a portal that must be sealed before All Saints Day.
